soldier.name: Soldier
soldier.description: You served in a garrison or a lord's levy. You know how to hold a line, march all day, and keep your blade clean.

scholar.name: Scholar
scholar.description: Years of books, lamplight and lectures. You learned a little of the old magic, and a great deal about what it costs.

outlaw.name: Outlaw
outlaw.description: There's a price on your head in Riverwatch, and you've learned to live quick and light because of it.

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.description: You grew up in the hills, reading tracks and weather. Wolves are no stranger to you.

acolyte.name: Acolyte
acolyte.description: Raised in a shrine, taught to tend the sick and keep the old rites. Your faith is quiet, but it has weight.

merchant.name: Merchant
merchant.description: You've haggled in every market from the coast to the river. Coin opens doors that swords can't.
